content.expected_result: All defined steps retain exact context, report currency honestly and respect native element ownership.
preconditions: Start with current board content and exact evidence saved in a real Git commit.

steps.action: Request a current-board element action without a content digest, then with a valid digest that no longer matches the opened page.
steps.expected_result: The requests return 400 and 409 respectively. A stale current page must reload instead of opening replacement evidence; explicit historical reads are a separate saved context.

steps.action: Use the shared diagram edit path on a diagram-sourced slide and submit a relative move against an outdated content digest.
steps.expected_result: The delta is rejected before application. Complete whiteboard publish remains a full replacement, not a relative edit endpoint.

steps.action: Attempt to publish a selection whose evidence ID is absent from its saved definition.
steps.expected_result: Publication fails instead of accepting an undeclared evidence selector for coverage.

content.title: Reject missing saved context and invalid whiteboard evidence publication

state.reason: The defined scenarios are implemented by the linked CLI, server and browser tests; this activates the definition without recording an execution verdict.
